subject: Re: HelioCorp dedicated capacity request — occupancy reservation and tactical hold
messages:
From: Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@heliocorp.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliocorp.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity for Q4 proof-of-scale (HelioCorp)

Naomi —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. HelioCorp is moving this POC into a prepaid proof-of-scale with a targeted start window of 2029-08-12. Procurement asked me to get an early confirmation from you on whether Redwood can put a short-term reservation on the GPU fleet for the initial 8x A100-class slots (we expect steady-state to be ~12k tokens/sec) and an option to scale to 16x in the first 30 days.

We understand these are finite resources. Can you confirm:
- Short-term hold mechanism and how long you can hold inventory without a signed SOW
- Exact SKU types you recommend (on-hosted vs dedicated pods) for throughput + predictable latency
- Our target go-live date is 2029-08-12; how much runway do you need to lock nodes?

Attaching our draft SOW and preliminary load profile. Procurement is on cc and asking for any standard SOC/escrow language we should expect. Appreciate a quick note — procurement would like a gating answer by next Monday (2029-07-22).

Best,
Alex
Director of ML Platform
HelioCorp

Attachments: helio_poc_sow_draft.pdf, helio_load_profile.xlsx
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity for Q4 proof-of-scale (HelioCorp) — request for tactical hold

Folks —

Forwarding Alex's ask. Helio is late-stage and wants a short reservation for 8 A100-class GPUs with an option to expand to 16. Procurement needs a gating answer by 07/22. Summary of what they asked:
- Short-term reservation window (pre-signature)
- SKU recommendation and latency guarantees
- Runway needed to lock nodes for 2029-08-12 go-live

Can ops validate inventory across regions (primary US-west), and advise whether we can place a 14-day "tactical hold" on the requested capacity without impacting other commitments? If we need a formal occupancy request or purchase commitment, call it out and include the minimal paperwork/proof.

I've attached the Helio load profile and the draft SOW for context. If we can do a soft hold, I want language we can give procurement to bridge to contract signing.

Thanks — can you prioritize?
Naomi
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity_snapshot_20290718.csv, helio_action_plan_v2.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity for Q4 proof-of-scale (HelioCorp) — ops readout

Naomi / team —

Quick inventory readout after checking runbook and scheduler:
- US-west pool currently has 32 A100-equivalent slots available for dedicated allocation; 6 are provisioned for long-term reserved customers (commitments) and 10 are earmarked for burst/shared pools.
- We can place a 14-day soft hold on 8 A100 slots in US-west as a manual reservation (internal flag) without creating allocation drift, provided there are no immediate queued activations this week.
- If Helio asks to expand to 16 within 30 days, we can support scale-up via a mix of dedicated + burst (quantized 8-bit) instances. That introduces a latency delta (~6–12ms p95 increase) which is within their acceptable tolerance per the load profile, but we should document it.
- Operational steps to formalize the hold: 1) sales to file an Occupancy Hold ticket (OPS-HOLD) with deal_id and start/end dates; 2) signed Letter of Intent (LOI) or purchase deposit to convert soft hold to guaranteed allocation; 3) ops will snapshot node telemetry and reserve instance IDs.

I've attached a quick snapshot (capacity_snapshot_20290718.csv) and a short action plan. If procurement needs pre-signature language, we can offer a non-binding "tactical hold" confirmation email that states we will not pledge those nodes to other customers for 14 days while Helio completes signature. This is not an SLA or contractual commitment.

Next steps:
- Naomi / sales: push LOI or deposit if they want guaranteed slots. If they prefer soft hold, confirm dates and acceptance of non-binding language.
- Ben: can you open OPS-HOLD and mark it high-priority?

Marcus Lin
Principal, Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity_snapshot_20290718.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@heliocorp.ai>, procurement@heliocorp.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2029 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelioCorp dedicated capacity request — occupancy reservation and tactical hold

Alex / Procurement —

Thanks for the clear ask. Naomi, Marcus — appreciate the fast ops check. Helio, we can provide the non-binding 14-day tactical hold on 8 A100-equivalent GPUs in US-west starting 2029-07-23 while you finalize procurement. To convert to a guaranteed allocation we require either: a) a signed LOI with a 10% deposit; or b) an executed SOW referencing the deal_id DL-2029-1147.

I will:
- Open a HubSpot activity and OPS-HOLD ticket this afternoon and include Marcus' capacity snapshot.
- Send a short tactical hold confirmation email (non-contractual) that Helio can show procurement.
- Share DocuSign link for LOI if you want to expedite (attached).

Helio — do you want the LOI docusign today (fastest), or do you want us to issue a tactical hold note and wait for the full SOW? If we don't hear back, the hold will expire 14 days after 2029-07-23.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
